card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit such as 0, 1 or 2 that sits in the middle of a number, usually the first digit of a two- or three-digit value or the digit after a decimal point. It is mostly seen in dose tables, ranges and section references.

modes.label: Leading digit in tables
modes.description: The first digit of a two-digit value in a row of numbers such as a dosing or weight table.

modes.label: Digit after a decimal point
modes.description: A 0 right after a decimal point in a concentration or dose.
modes.example: 0.925 MBq/kg to 1.85 MBq/kg (0.025 mCi/kg to 0.<<0>>5 mCi/kg).

modes.label: Digit in section references
modes.description: A digit partway through a cross-reference number in parentheses.

card.writes: It promotes number-word tokens like 五个 and 六个 and suppresses the digit 0, so it seems to discourage a 0 as the next digit.
card.plain: It fires on a digit inside a longer number, as in doses, table values and section numbers.
